CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   C. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.
   C. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.
   D. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

7. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
   B. Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Story: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Story: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Trust Christian Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Responsibility Christian and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prayer Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
